equations.9_10: unweighted mean of the accuracies in each dimension
equations.11_13: min and max over models and prompting conditions jointly, separately per dimension, then min-max scaled to [0, 1]

column_vs_dataset: the reported tables carry 10 knowledge and 20 reasoning columns over 24 distinct datasets; HaluEval is 3 columns, AIME 4 and AI2-ARC 2. --average column (default) reproduces the published figure and weights those datasets 3x/4x/2x; --average dataset collapses them first for an equal-weight per-dataset mean
taxonomy_note: the results tables score QASC under knowledge and PubMedQA under reasoning; Appendix A.1.1 assigns them the other way round. --taxonomy tables (default) reproduces the published figure
